commitResults.messageTitle: Fix the version and data location in the UG
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide still said it covers version 1.4. It also said the data is
saved next to the JAR file, but HuntR resolves data/addressbook.json,
preferences.json and data/backups from the folder where it runs, which
is not necessarily the folder that contains the JAR file.

State version 1.5 and describe the data file, and the data folder in the
FAQ, as being in the folder where HuntR runs, like the rest of the guide.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix the About Us page and the README for v1.5
commitResults.messageBody:
The About Us page still had parts of the original project: a contact
email address, a link to the sample portfolio page of John Doe, and a
link to a portfolio page of Joshua that does not exist. Remove the three
and delete the sample page and its image, which nothing else uses.

Resize the photos of Dylan and Joshua to 400 pixels wide, as they are
shown 200 pixels wide. They were 3.9 MB and 1 MB, which made the page
slow to load.

The README still described v1.4 and the old window. Say v1.5, describe
the current window as the home page does, and mention restore.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix UG error message for overlong delete ID
commitResults.messageBody:
The delete section lists the "1 to 20 characters long and contain only
letters, digits, hyphens and underscores" message for an ID longer than
20 characters. HuntR actually shows "Employee ID should be at most 20
characters long.", which is also what the team section documents.

Let's list the overlong-ID case as its own row with the message HuntR
shows, so the table matches the app.

Part of #231
Document pasted-tab limitation in the User Guide
Fix the version and data location in the UG
Fix the About Us page and the README for v1.5
Fix UG error message for overlong delete ID
Added a new known issue regarding pasted-tab limitation.
